# CORE-DEM-01

**Does the design state its goals, its non-goals and its stakeholders with their concerns?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | DEM: Demand and drivers |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `drivers.goals`, `drivers.non_goals`, `drivers.stakeholders` |

## Why it matters

An architecture is evaluated against stakeholder concerns; without them there is nothing to judge it against.

## Rule

drivers.goals has at least one entry, drivers.non_goals is present, and every stakeholder has at least one concern.

## Sources

- ISO/IEC/IEEE 42030:2019, Architecture evaluation framework (`iso42030`)
- ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022, Architecture description (`iso42010`)
